**If it was movement detection — what is behind your laptop?**
Blinds, a tiled floor, brick, a radiator, or anything with a repeating pattern
is a known weakness: the detector cannot tell a passer-by from the machine being
moved. Open Settings → Test sensitivity, wave your hand in front of the camera
without touching the laptop, and tell me what the number does.
